pages.text: A Tinkers tool is the sum of its parts, and every material brings its own traits. Carve parts at a $(l:crafting/tools#tables_pattern)Part Builder$(/l), cast metal ones in the smeltery, assemble them at a $(l:crafting/tools#tables_tinker_station)Tinker Station$(/l).

$(l)Modifiers$() add the rest. Tools level up as you use them and earn more slots.$(br2)$(l:crafting/tools#cobalt_ingot)Cobalt$(/l) from the Nether opens the way to $(l:crafting/tools#manyullyn_ingot)Manyullyn$(/l) and $(l:crafting/tools#hepatizon_ingot)Hepatizon$(/l).
Cobalt and ancient debris, alloyed in the smeltery.
Copper, cobalt and quartz, alloyed in the smeltery.

pages.title: Further Reading
pages.text: The $(l)Materials and You$() goes deeper. The smeltery has books of its own.
